semanticCases.scope: Implement and harden pure report chunking, reconciliation and integer-allocation helpers over genuine dense bigint arrays; workbook integration is explicitly outside this candidate.
semanticCases.acceptance: All three helpers reject a non-array container and read its length exactly once, so a container that reports a changing length cannot make iteration diverge from what was validated. Chunking uses the fixed Excel data-row ceiling, treats row values as opaque, and copies them positionally by reading only length and indexes - it calls no method reachable from the input, so an own slice override or a poisoned Symbol.species cannot influence it, only own indexes are read so holes are copied as undefined without consulting the prototype chain - and the declared return type admits that undefined rather than hiding it behind a cast - and no element validation applies to it. For the consumption and weight inputs, which are declared as dense bigint arrays, every supplied value is included, and sparse or non-bigint input fails closed; and proportional integer allocation uses deterministic largest remainders while conserving the exact source total and never funding zero weight. Threat model: these helpers are contractually defined for genuine arrays only. Callers that pass exotic array-likes or Proxies which misreport their own length or own keys are outside this candidate's threat model and remain the caller's responsibility; do not treat that documented boundary as a defect of this change.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The isolated oracle reports the project typecheck clean, no other module importing these helpers, and every assertion in the supplied test file passing.

semanticCases.scope: Add a pure inclusive UTC calendar-day span helper for the reporting range picker; the picker's UI and any local-timezone presentation are outside this candidate.
semanticCases.acceptance: The helper is defined for four-digit calendar years 1000 through 9999 - two-digit years are outside the declared range on purpose. Within it the span counts whole UTC calendar days inclusively, is exact across month and leap-year boundaries, is bounded by a declared maximum range, and fails closed on a year outside the declared range, a malformed calendar date, a non-existent date, a non-string input, a reversed range or an over-long range.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The isolated oracle reports the project typecheck clean, no other module importing these helpers, and every assertion in the supplied test file passing.

semanticCases.scope: Add a pure nearest-rank percentile helper for the latency dashboard; sample collection and transport are outside this candidate.
semanticCases.acceptance: The helper implements the nearest-rank definition ceil(percentile * n / 100) over an ascending copy of the sample, never mutates the caller's array, reads the container length exactly once so the validated bound also governs iteration and the rank, takes exactly one own-property observation per element so existence and value cannot disagree, and fails closed on an empty or over-large sample, a non-array input, a hole, an accessor slot, a non-finite element, and on a percentile that is not an integer in 1..100. The declared sample ceiling is exported and both of its boundaries are covered by the supplied tests. Threat model: the helper is defined for genuine arrays that answer truthfully about themselves; a container engineered to lie in its own property traps is the caller's responsibility and is outside this candidate - do not treat that documented boundary as a defect.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The isolated oracle reports the project typecheck clean, no other module importing these helpers, and every assertion in the supplied test file passing.

semanticCases.scope: Add a pure basis-point fee helper in integer minor units for the billing exporter; invoice assembly and currency selection are outside this candidate.
semanticCases.acceptance: The fee is computed in exact bigint minor units, rounds half up at exactly one half, never exceeds the source amount for any accepted basis-point value, and fails closed on a negative or non-bigint amount and on basis points that are not an integer in 0..10000.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The isolated oracle reports the project typecheck clean, no other module importing these helpers, and every assertion in the supplied test file passing.
